summary: GeoPark filed a 6-K announcing completion of its strategic Venezuela entry: the 25-year Bare Block CPP became effective after early satisfaction of contractual and regulatory milestones, and GeoPark issued 42,135,872 common shares to Panamerican Energy Holdings S.A. (Grupo Gilinski) for the remaining 95% of CPP Holdco, adding to its initial 5%. Consideration was all-equity with no cash payment, giving Gilinski roughly 56.3% and control; up to 5,421,589 additional shares may follow. GeoPark operates with 65% net participating interest, funding 100% of capex, targeting operational takeover before year-end 2026 and subsequent consolidation. Watch governance/control overhang and earnout dilution.
